items.stem: Stalin became General Secretary of the Communist Party in April 1922. ‘Stalin rose to power mainly because of his position as General Secretary.’ Discuss.

Against: His rivals' mistakes, especially Trotsky's. His shifting alliances and tactical skill. Socialism in One Country appealed to a war-weary party.
